subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should this be fixed as a Telegram plain-group updateLastRoute change, as a shared non-direct session fallback, or held until live Telegram restart proof narrows the boundary?
rationale: Current source supports a remaining plain-group route gap, but the related Mattermost work suggests a broader shared fix; maintainers need to choose the owner boundary before automation changes compatibility-sensitive session routing.

options.title: Reproduce then choose boundary
options.body: Run live current-main Telegram group restart proof first, then land the smallest Telegram or shared-session fix that matches the observed failing path.

options.title: Adopt shared fallback
options.body: Refresh or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/77442 if maintainers want core to derive missing non-direct delivery routes from inbound context.

options.title: Use Telegram-only fix
options.body: Revive the all-groups updateLastRoute shape from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/45610 if maintainers want Telegram to always persist group routes itself.

recommendation.title: Reproduce then choose boundary
recommendation.body: Run live current-main Telegram group restart proof first, then land the smallest Telegram or shared-session fix that matches the observed failing path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the shared session recorder, current file touches, and adjacent route persistence reviews.
